title: PlayStation Plus ekim 2026 ücretsiz oyunları açıklandı
summary: Sony, PlayStation Plus aboneleri için ekim ayında verilecek üç yeni ücretsiz oyunu duyurdu. F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 ve Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 6 Ekim'den itibaren indirilebilecek.
body:
PlayStation Plus ekim 2026 ücretsiz oyunları kapsamında abonelerin kütüphanesine eklenecek yapımlar Sony tarafından duyuruldu. Polygon'un aktardığına göre, bu ay tüm abonelik kademelerindeki oyuncular için üç farklı yapım erişime açılacak.

## Hangi oyunlar ücretsiz veriliyor?

Polygon ve VGC'nin paylaştığı bilgilere göre, aboneler **F1 25**, **Hunt: Showdown 1896** ve Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 oyunlarını hiçbir ek ücret ödemeden kütüphanelerine ekleyebilecek. EA Sports imzalı yarış oyunu F1 25, oyunculara hem çevrimdışı kariyer modları hem de rekabetçi çevrim içi yarışlar sunuyor. Crytek tarafından geliştirilen Hunt: Showdown 1896, oyuncuları Amerikan sınırındaki bataklıklarda canavarlarla ve diğer avcılarla mücadele ettiren bir nişancı yapımı olarak öne çıkıyor. D3 Publisher yapımı Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 ise oyuncuların devasa düşmanlara karşı kübik dünyayı savunduğu renkli bir alternatif sunuyor.

## İndirme tarihleri ve detaylar

Bu üç oyun, 6 Ekim Salı gününden başlayarak 2 Kasım Pazartesi gününe kadar indirilmek üzere kütüphanelere eklenebilecek. Aboneler, eylül ayının ücretsiz oyunları olan Chained Echoes, Sniper Elite: Resistance, Wobbly Life ve MLB The Show 26 yapımlarını ise 5 Ekim'e kadar talep edebilecek.

**Neden önemli?** PlayStation Plus Essential aboneliği sahipleri, aylık oyun seçkisi sayesinde ek bir maliyet olmadan farklı türlerdeki popüler yapımları deneyimleme fırsatı buluyor.

source_texts.title: PlayStation Plus October 2026 Free Games Lineup Officially Revealed
source_texts.summary: Sony's free PlayStation Plus Essential games for October 2026 have been announced, and include three wildly different games.
source_texts.text:
On Wednesday, Sony revealed the next batch of PlayStation Plus subscribers' free Essential games. Like most months, there's a little something for everyone on offer: F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896, and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 will be free for subscribers. You'll be able to start downloading the games on Oct. 6.
F1 25
EA has a game for every sport, and that includes the increasingly popular Formula One racing. F1 25 is the latest entry in the series, and received a paid expansion in June for the 2026 season, which includes new teams, drivers, and cars. Race offline in the Konnersport Career and My Team modes, or test your driving skills against other players online.
Hunt: Showdown 1896
Hunt: Showdown 1896 is a first-person extraction shooter. You'll duke it out with ruthless monsters in the backwaters of the American Frontier across four different maps. Of course, it wouldn't be an extraction shooter if you weren't targeting other Hunters to get that sweet, sweet loot each match. You can try to hunt solo or in teams or two or three.
Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2
Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is a wildly different shooter than Hunt: Showdown 1896. It's much brighter and colorful, and full of giant voxel enemies to destroy. The Earth is in danger, and it's up to you to defend it in single-player or four-player co-op modes. Select a squad from over 100 characters and outfit them with over 600 weapons and accessories to help save the planet.
F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896, and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 will be available until Nov. 2. You can still grab September's free PlayStation Plus Essential games — Chained Echoes, Sniper Elite: Resistance, Wobbly Life, and MLB The Show 26 — through Oct. 5.
PlayStation Plus Essential is the lowest tier of Sony’s subscription game service. It offers online multiplayer access, a monthly assortment of free PS4 and PS5 games, cloud storage, and discounts on PlayStation Store purchases. PlayStation Plus Essential costs $79.99 annually, $27.99 for a three-month subscription, or $10.99 monthly, following a price hike across all tiers of PS Plus in May.

source_texts.text:
PlayStation has revealed the next three games coming to all PS Plus tiers this month, including F1 25 for PS5.
The EA Sports racer is joined by Crytek shooter Hunt: Showdown 1896 (PS5) and D3âs Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 (PS4, PS5).
All three games will be available to PlayStation Plus members from Tuesday, October 6 until Monday, November 2.
As ever, players who claim the games will be able to continue playing them after theyâre no longer available to claim, as long as they remain subscribed to any PlayStation Plus tier.
PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, October 5, to add Sniper Elite: Resistance, MLB The Show 26, Wobbly Life, and Chained Echoes to their game libraries.
PlayStation Plus Games for October 2026
F1 25 | PS5
Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship. Enjoy single player experiences such as Career and My Team 2.0, letting you create your own F1 stories as you take control as the Owner of a Formula 1 team. Then take the race online against other players, including a brand new multiplayer mode in F1 World, where you and your friends race as a squad against AI drivers.
—
Hunt: Showdown 1896 | PS5
Hunt: Showdown 1896 is a new era of the addictively unforgiving extraction shooter. In corrupted backwaters lost to history, fight back alone â or with friends â against timeless evil. Twisted monsters and other ruthless Hunters stand between you and your Bounty. Risk everything as Hunt consumes you. Race competing Hunters to track down bosses, send them to hell, claim their bounty, and fight your way to extract. If others only slow you down, go alone. If you find strength in numbers, take up to two teammates along.
—
Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 | PS5, PS4
The square Earth is under attack by giant enemies. Teammates scattered around the world are waiting to be rescued. Select 4 teammates from among those you have collected and create your own team. Design the team perfect for your play style, select your equipment, and then deploy to battle. In addition to soldiers from the mainline EDF series, this game also includes soldiers from the EDF spin-offs, and enemies who ravaged the planet in previous releases have also crossed over into this world to join the fight. Enjoy fighting numerous enemies, including redesigned voxel versions of old favorites, as well as new enemies unique to this release. Enjoy four player online co-op and two player local split screen on PS5 and PS4.
